title: 第893章 狐族涂山第892章 不算完
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
“没错！”
“斩杀这些妖族，只是偿还他们屠戮我宗门弟子的血债，仅仅只是还本而已！”
“血仇已报，可他们挑衅我太虚宗的代价，至今未付！”
“既然这群妖族主动作死，招惹到咱们头上！”
“那咱们就顺势出手，拔掉长生天妖族盘踞的几座城池据点！”
“当做此次事端的利息！”
“这也是理所应当，天经地义的事情嘛！”
柳惊天双目锋芒暴涨，周身残余的剑道锐气再次微微震荡开来。
他这些年行走长生天，始终顾全人族大局，处处忍让妖族纷争。
哪怕屡次被妖族挑衅冒犯，也只能强行压下心中杀意。
今日终于有正大光明的由头清算妖族旧账，他心中积压多年的郁气一扫而空。
此刻的他，早已战意沸腾，恨不得立刻杀向妖族据点。
修行界本就是弱肉强食的残酷世道，恩怨情仇从来不会一笔勾销。
若是只报仇、不索赔，只会让异族觉得人族软弱可欺、太过好说话。
久而久之，只会滋生更多肆无忌惮的挑衅与进犯。
凌宇轻轻点头，神色平静，眼底却藏着一丝不容置疑的果决。
“就是这个道理。”
“杀人偿命，只是修士界最基础的规矩。”
“敢挑衅我太虚宗的威严，就得付出资源、地盘、势力崩塌的惨痛代价。”
“唯有这样，才能彻底打怕长生天所有盘踞的妖族势力。”

“让他们百年、千年都不敢再觊觎、冒犯我人族修士分毫。”
柳惊天紧握双拳，一身战意彻底昂扬，忍不住抚掌大笑。
“说得好！”
“既然他们主动惹事挑衅，那咱们就直接掀了他们的老窝！”
柳惊天眼中剑光熠熠闪烁，整个人意气风发。
“好！”
“那就这么定了！”
“我这几日刚刚突破剑道瓶颈，修为稳固大涨，正愁没有强敌磨砺剑意。”
“今日便拿这些妖族据点，来好好祭我天意四象剑阵！”
凌宇微微颔首，目光远眺，望向雷音谷外连绵起伏、一望无际的茫茫群山。
“不过，在此之前，我们需要先搞清楚妖族的势力分布。”
“查明白他们在长生天西南区域，所有重要的城池与据点位置。”
“知己知彼，方能百战不殆，不打无准备之仗。”
柳惊天瞬间收敛满脸笑意，神色变得郑重肃穆。
“此事不难。”
“天南城太虚宗驻地经营多年，早已将周边妖族势力摸得一清二楚。”
“我们回去之后，让孙长老整理出完整情报，筛选几处核心据点，逐一拔除。”
“好。”
凌宇最后深深看了一眼下方那片被夷为平地的巨型深坑，淡淡开口。
“走吧，先回驻地。”

两人身形一晃，化作两道流光，转身飞速离开雷音谷山脊。
就在两人离去没多久，一道极其恐怖的漆黑身影，破空降临雷音谷上空。
来人正是妖族顶尖大能，涂山。
他悬浮在数百里宽的巨型深坑上空，周身萦绕着深沉如海的恐怖妖威。
content_en:
"That's right!"
"Killing these monsters is just to repay their blood debt for slaughtering my sect disciples. It is just repayment!"
"The blood feud has been avenged, but the price they paid for provoking my Taixu Sect has not yet been paid!"
"Since this group of monsters took the initiative to kill themselves, they have provoked us!"
"Then let's take advantage of the situation and pull out several city strongholds occupied by the Immortal Demon Clan!"
"As interest for this incident!"
"This is also a matter of course and a matter of course!"
Liu Jingtian's eyes sharpened sharply, and the remaining kendo aura around him began to vibrate slightly again.
He has been walking in the Immortal Heaven for these years, always taking into account the overall interests of the human race and tolerating the disputes between the demon race and the demon race.
Even if he was repeatedly provoked and offended by the demon clan, he could only suppress the murderous intention in his heart.
Today, he finally had an honest reason to settle the old debts of the demon clan, and the depression that had accumulated in his heart for many years was swept away.
At this moment, his fighting spirit was boiling, and he wanted to kill the demon tribe's stronghold immediately.
The world of spiritual practice is a cruel world where the weak eat the strong, and grievances and grudges will never be written off in one go.
If we only seek revenge without claiming compensation, it will only make the foreign race think that the human race is weak and easy to bully.
Over time, it will only breed more unscrupulous provocations and aggression.
Ling Yu nodded slightly, his expression calm, but there was a hint of unquestionable determination in his eyes.
"That's the truth."
"Killing for life is just the most basic rule in the monk world."
"If you dare to challenge the majesty of our Taixu Sect, you will have to pay a heavy price in terms of resources, territory, and power collapse."
"Only in this way can we completely defeat all the demon forces entrenched in Changshengtian."
"Let them not dare to covet or offend my human monks for a hundred or a thousand years."
Liu Jingtian clenched his fists, his fighting spirit was completely high, and he couldn't help but hold his hands and laugh.
"Well said!"
"Since they are taking the initiative to cause trouble and provocation, then we will directly destroy their lair!"
Liu Jingtian's eyes flashed with sword light, and he was full of high spirits.
"Okay!"
"Then it's settled!"
"I have just broken through the bottleneck of swordsmanship in the past few days, and my cultivation has increased steadily. I am worried that I will not have a strong opponent to sharpen my swordsmanship."
"Today, I will use these monster clan strongholds to sacrifice my Four Symbols Sword Formation of God's Will!"
Ling Yu nodded slightly and looked far away, looking at the endless rolling mountains outside Leiyin Valley.
"However, before that, we need to understand the distribution of the demon clan's power first."
"Find out the locations of all their important cities and strongholds in the southwest area of Changshengtian."
“Only by knowing yourself and your enemy can you fight a hundred battles without danger and never fight an unprepared battle.”
Liu Jingtian instantly stopped smiling and his expression became solemn and solemn.
"It's not difficult."
"Tiannan City's Taixu Sect has been operating for many years, and it has already clearly understood the surrounding demon clan forces."
"After we go back, let Elder Sun sort out the complete information, screen several core strongholds, and remove them one by one."
"Okay."
Ling Yu took one last deep look at the huge, flattened pit below and spoke calmly.
"Let's go back to the station first."
The two people's bodies swayed, turned into two streams of light, turned around and quickly left the ridge of Leiyin Valley.
Not long after the two people left, an extremely terrifying dark figure appeared in the sky above Leiyin Valley.
The person who came was none other than the top powerhouse of the Monster Clan, Tu Shan.
He was suspended in the sky above a giant pit hundreds of miles wide, surrounded by a terrifying demon power as deep as the sea.
